world_cup.summary: Spain WON the 2026 FIFA World Cup (second title, first since 2010): beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time at MetLife (New York New Jersey Stadium) on Sun 19 July 2026, Ferran Torres 106'. Spain were unbeaten across 8 games (W7 D1), kept 7 clean sheets and conceded 1 goal (Unai Simon, Golden Glove). Yamal, 19 years 6 days old at the final, played all 120 minutes, became the first teenager ever to win both the Euros and the World Cup, but scored 1 goal / 0 assists in 8 games and did NOT win a FIFA individual award (Golden Ball: Rodri; Best Young Player: Pau Cubarsi; Golden Boot: Mbappe, 10). He came in managing a hamstring injury (torn on 22 April 2026) and was eased in from 25 minutes off the bench.

records_confirmed: First-ever teenager to win both the Euros and the World Cup (ESPN final stats). World Soccer Talk: youngest player to win both.
19 years 6 days at the final whistle = tied 4th-youngest World Cup winner (ESPN); only Pele, Bergomi, Ronaldo younger (World Soccer Talk).

6th appearance of the tournament = most by any player aged 18 or younger at a WC (ESPN).
With Pau Cubarsi, first pair of teenagers to start a WC match for one nation since Pele & Altafini (Brazil v Wales, 1958) - FIFA via Barca Buzz / ESPN.
Started 13 major-tournament games for Spain (Euro 2024 + WC 2026) and won all 13 (World Soccer Talk; ESPN/Yahoo 'keeps incredible tournament record intact').
8th-youngest goalscorer in World Cup history (Deccan Chronicle) after the Saudi Arabia goal.
Final: Messi (b. June 1987) v Yamal (b. July 2007) = first WC final with starters 20+ years apart (20y 19d) (ESPN).
